property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the XMLImportPreference (a Application or Document).

property.name: importToSelected
property.shortdesc: If true, imports into the selected XML element. If false, imports at the root element.

property.name: importStyle
property.shortdesc: The style of incorporating imported XML content into the document.

property.name: createLinkToXML
property.shortdesc: If true, creates a link to the imported XML file. If false, embeds the file.

property.name: repeatTextElements
property.shortdesc: If true, repeating text elements inherit the formatting applied to placeholder text. Note: Valid only when import style is merge.

property.name: ignoreUnmatchedIncoming
property.shortdesc: If true, ignores elements that do not match the existing structure. Note: Valid only when import style is merge.

property.name: importTextIntoTables
property.shortdesc: If true, imports text into tables if tags match placeholder tables and their cells. Note: Valid only when import style is merge.

property.name: ignoreWhitespace
property.shortdesc: If true, leaves existing content in place if the matching XML content contains only whitespace characters such as a carriage return or a tab character. Note: Valid only when import style is merge.

property.name: removeUnmatchedExisting
property.shortdesc: If true, deletes existing elements or placeholders in the document that do not have matches in the XML file. Note: Valid only when import style is merge.

property.name: allowTransform
property.shortdesc: If true, transforms the XML using an XSLT file.

property.name: transformFilename
property.shortdesc: The name of the XSLT file. Note: Valid when allow transform is true. Can return: File or XMLTransformFile enumerator.

property.name: transformParameters
property.shortdesc: Stylesheet parameters as a list of name/value pairs in the format [[name, value], [name, value], ...]. Can return: Ordered array containing name:String, value:String.

property.name: importCALSTables
property.shortdesc: If true, imports CALS tables as InDesign tables.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the XMLImportPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
